why: Codex reads MCP servers from [mcp_servers.<name>] tables in .codex/config.toml, a format no JSON reader sees. The fail side declares one server that downloads a Python package and starts it, with no acceptance; the pass side is the same file plus its exact fingerprint in .rebar-injection-allowlist. Whoever leaves TOML out turns the fail side into not-applicable; whoever fingerprints a TOML server differently from the same launch in JSON turns the pass side red.
